name: ST STDC14 (STLINK-V3)
mates: An STLINK-V3 probe (STLINK-V3SET, STLINK-V3MINIE, and others) through its 14-wire STDC14 flat cable, into a 2×7 1.27 mm (0.05 in) header on the target such as Samtec FTSH-107-01-L-DV-K-A.
connector: 2×7, 1.27 mm (0.05 in) pitch, keyed (Samtec FTSH-107-01-L-DV-K-A on the probe)
numbering: Pins 1 to 14 as on a 2-row FTSH header: odd pins in one row, even pins in the other, pin 1 at the key. UM2448 says pins 3 to 12 follow the Arm 10-pin Cortex debug pinout, so STDC14 pin n is Cortex 10-pin pin n−2. The manual's text gives the table only; check the header's own drawing for which row is which.

source.title: UM2448 User manual, STLINK-V3SET debugger/programmer for STM8 and STM32, Table 6. STDC14 connector (CN1) pinout
